### Welcome!

I am a Research Engineer/Scientist with a solid background in electronics and software/hardware integration. My work focuses on applying AI and biosensing to develop reliable (and cool) wearable health monitoring systems. 

I am always exploring innovative ways to translate technological advances into meaningful healthcare impact.
